 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women South P.S.
has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Santhoshi.
A The gist of the prosecution case is that Accused No.1 got married to CW-1 on  3  C.C.No.28623/2022 14-02-2019.

After the marriage, while CW-1 residing with Accused No.1 at Chickballapura, Accused No.1 and 2 pressurized CW-1 to give gold jewels to Accused No.3 to meet the expenses of house building construction.
When CW-1 refused to do so, Accused No.1 to Accused No.4 tortured CW1 physically and mentally.
While undergoing treatment for thyroid by CW-1, Accused No.1 left her in paternal house.
CW-1 tried to call Accused No.1, but Accused No.1 did not receive the calls.

When CW 1 to 3 came to his house,
Accused did not allow them inside the house and thus subjected Santhoshi A vs Manjunath on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83428318/

2 CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry and, after the marriage while residing, the Accused No.1 to 4 with common intention harassed CW-1 in demand of gold jewels and tortured her and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.86/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. Basavanagudi Women south P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged  4  C.C.No.28623/2022 on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 to 4 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 to 4 after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

sentences.text: 6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  5  C.C.No.28623/2022  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.4 of  Dowry Prohibition Act..?
2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Santhoshi.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 14-06-2019 and deposed after the Santhoshi A vs Manjunath on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83428318/
4

sentences.text: marriage
, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted and threatened to her.
PW-1  6  C.C.No.28623/2022 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
 7  C.C.No.28623/2022 and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution Santhoshi A vs Manjunath on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83428318/
5 has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 4 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 4 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
